scientific_scope: passive within-sequence association; no calibration, covariance, weighting, or control output
scientific_unit: last recorded publication per unique stable edge; rolling republications are not independent

edge_conditioning.rotation: maximum over associated scan samples and all three rotational Schur condition modes
edge_conditioning.translation: maximum over associated scan samples and all three translational Schur condition modes
edge_conditioning.occupancy_denominator: valid associated Hessian samples eligible for the corresponding absolute mask

temporal_block_bootstrap.block_origin: first GT-valid unique edge end timestamp

primary_analysis: log maximum rotational condition ratio versus rotational GT edge error
log maximum translational condition ratio versus translational GT edge error
rotational absolute-degenerate occupancy versus rotational GT edge error
translational absolute-degenerate occupancy versus translational GT edge error
absolute-degenerate persistence versus separate rotational and translational GT edge errors
explicit_non_goals: active factor weighting, gating, or rejection
using ground truth in Stage 1 reference construction
